title: Custom printed logo stickers
short_description: Your logo on a sticker that seals bags, boxes and wraps. Round and rectangular logo stickers in gloss or matte.
description:
Three formats: 30 mm and 40 mm round, and a 100 × 60 mm rectangle. Stickers are the cheapest way to brand everything you already use — seal a bag, close a box, label a wrap. Choose the size and finish, then send us your logo.

Seal a [printed paper bag](/paper-bags/printed-paper-bags/) or a [cake and pastry box](/bakery-packaging/pastry-boxes/) with the same logo.

Your digital proof and print plates are included in the price. Final specifications are confirmed with your written quote.

faqs.q: Can I use my own design?
faqs.a: Yes. Share your logo or print-ready artwork when requesting a quote. We will confirm the artwork requirements for your chosen item, and you approve a digital proof before anything is printed.

faqs.q: What if my artwork is not ready?
faqs.a: You can request a quote first and share your artwork later. Tell us what you have in mind and we can discuss the next steps.

The prices on this page are indicative and exclude VAT, which is added at 20%. Your digital proof and print plates are included, and delivery is free to a single UK mainland address. We confirm everything in a written quote before you commit.

faqs.q: Can I have a different shape or size?
faqs.a: Yes — square and custom-cut stickers are available. Use “Request a custom quantity”, tell us the size and shape, and we will quote it.
As a general guide, allow several weeks from artwork approval to delivery. We will confirm current timing with your quote.

copy.gallery_caption: Illustrative design concepts. Artwork, colours and construction are confirmed with your quote.

steps.title: Choose your sticker.
steps.text: Select your size, finish and quantity. We’ll confirm the details and your trade quote.

steps.title: Share your artwork.
steps.text: Send us your logo or design. We’ll agree the print requirements and send a digital proof before production.

steps.title: Approve, print, stick.
steps.text: Once the artwork is approved, we’ll confirm the production and delivery schedule.
